messages:
maria: Heads up — planning to roll the kernel+quant bundle (engine-kernel v3.14.0-q8 + quant q8a-2026-11) into staging tomorrow during the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window. Need signoff on pin TTL, canary slices, and rollback triggers.
lin: SGTM. Can we do a small canary first (1%) then 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m steps?
devon: 1% -> 10% sounds fine. Add a 5m smoke after the 10% step to check KV cache hitrate and p95.
sam: Agree. Key metrics to watch: p50/p95 latency, error-rate (5xx), and inference timeout counts. If p95 increases >20% or error-rate delta >0.5% we stop.
anya: Also add memory/oom alerts for the new kernel ABI change — I saw a small mem spike in perf tests. Can ops set a temporary mem cap? :warning:
deploybot: [deploybot] scheduling rollout: engine-kernel@3.14.0-q8 + quant:q8a-2026-11 -> staging. Canary steps: 1%, 10%, 50%, 100%. Auto-rollback: enabled. Pin TTL default: 24h.
lin: Can we pin the older kernel in prod as a fallback during the night window? i.e., keep engine-kernel@3.13.x available to fallback policy.
maria: Yes—fallback policy will prefer 3.13.x for critical routes. But we should pin 3.14.0-q8 to the staging pool only for smoke. In prod we do controlled shift.
opsbot: Creating temporary quarantine rule: max-concurrent-instances-per-node=8 for the canary pool.
devon: For rollout CLI:
```
# pin staging bundle for smoke
deploybot pin engine-kernel@3.14.0-q8 --env=staging --until=2026-11-02T06:00:00Z
# start canary
deploybot rollout engine-kernel@3.14.0-q8 --canary-schedule="1,10,50,100" --step-interval=30m
```
maria: Nice. Add the release notes link in the rollout comment so SRE can triage: https://internal.redwood/release/engine-kernel/3.14.0-q8 — includes ABI diffs and quantization checklist.
sam: If we see the KV cache miss rate jump >10% during the 10% or 50% step, we should pause and run quick heapdump+snap. Tagging @devon on runbook.
devon: Got it. I'll prepare a quick revert patch: engine-kernel@3.13.9-hotfix-rollback that drops the ABI and uses previous matmul kernels.
anya: One more ask — include the perf-eval prompt set (long-context) as part of the smoke so we don't regress on tail-latency. I pushed the prompt set to: s3://perf-evals/engine/long-context-2026-10-31.json
maria: Perfect. After staging smoke we target a staggered prod shift next night (02:00-06:00 UTC). Ops: ensure on-call rotation covers that window.
opsbot: On-call assigned: sam -> lin -> devon for 02:00-06:00 UTC (2026-11-03). Pager routing enabled.
deploybot: Rollout status: staged. Awaiting manual start from @maria.
maria: I'll kick off at 02:05 UTC if the final canary cost checks are green. Everyone stay near Slack for the first 90m. :thumbsup:
lin: I'll monitor dashboards and logs; ping me if we hit the pause thresholds.
sam: Will watch latency and errors. Have rollback command ready.
devon: I'll be on standby to run the binary pin/unpin if needed.
anya: I'll run the evaluation harness during the 10% and 50% steps and post outputs.
maria: thanks all — leaving the rollout comment and release notes pinned in the ops channel. If anything changes, post here and we'll update the plan. :rocket:
